::: {#exr-base-rate}

#### A test that is right 99% of the time

A screening test for a disease is positive for $99\%$ of people who have it
and negative for $99\%$ of people who do not.
One person in a thousand has the disease.

A randomly screened person tests positive.
What is the probability that they have the disease?
Guess first, then compute it with @eq-bayes.

:::
